print_review.scope: FCF/FTF fairings, four moving controls, two rails. No installed geometry edits. Toolpath/mesh evidence only; no physical print claim.
print_review.method: All Bridge-infill moves in exact final G-code checked. Uncovered intervals use0.45mm-wide preceding0.4mm object extrusion/current perimeters and support paths within0.8mm. This is a toolpath proxy, not physical sag prediction. Exact STEP/inputSTL/processedSTL/G-code hashes and settings verified. Support access:101 sampled zero-radius rays per fairing; all FTF samples have cardinal exit;98 FCF samples have cardinal exit and remaining3 have51–75/256 unblocked oblique directions. Finite tool access and break strength remain untested.
findings: Original upright FTF60.15mm cavity roof rejected; selected front-end-down removes that span.

Selected FCF everywhere supports include bridges; FTF buildplate-only supports. Final maximum uncovered intervalsFCF10.18mm/FTF14.18mm. Qualify a representative15mm bridge and support breakout with actual printer/material.
Exact final AR/AL maximum uncovered interval3.63mm; TRC8.20mm/TLC6.47mm. Legacy horn-pocket roof resolved. Local edge paths still require actual printer qualification.
AR/AL require3.2x17mm post-print horn slot. No control internal supports; fit end plugs after horns.
Aligned rails have zero Bridge-infill moves and no Overhang-perimeter mass, with~110mm2 first-layer object footprint.
All eight meshes watertight with positive volume; physical thin-wall adhesion/strength untested.

No sampled support point fully enclosed after cardinal/oblique visibility checks. Break supports out through open fairing side; inspect window corners and mating lips. Ray visibility does not establish finite tool clearance.

TRC/TLC retain slicer Low bed adhesion warnings at263mm height despite8mm brim. This is an explicit actual-printer adhesion gate; no floating-anchor or long-bridge warnings remain. Other six reviewed parts have no slicer warnings.
